2026_01_DAL_NYG.headline: Giants' explosives, protection propel them past Cowboys in Harbaugh's debut
2026_01_DAL_NYG.paragraph1: The New York Giants' offense, led by quarterback Jaxson Dart, utilized explosive plays and effective protection to outmaneuver the Dallas Cowboys' defense. Dart connected with tight end Isaiah Likely for two touchdowns, while running back Cam Skattebo added 81 rushing yards and a score. The Giants' ability to convert on third down (9-11) and control the clock (36:40) limited the Cowboys' opportunities. Dallas quarterback Dak Prescott completed 22 of 34 passes for 175 yards and two touchdowns but was hindered by penalties and the Giants' pass rush.

2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Mahomes Returns to Face Broncos' Pass Rush
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: The Denver Broncos' pass rush, which led the NFL in sacks for two consecutive seasons, will face a stiff test against Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes, who is returning from a season-ending knee injury. Mahomes' ability to extend plays and make plays outside of the pocket will be key, as will the Broncos' ability to protect quarterback Bo Nix. The Chiefs' offensive line, led by undrafted rookie Khalil Benson at left tackle, will face a tough challenge against the Broncos' pass rush.
